title: LatchGitRepositoryV2
description: One folder on the gateway host resolved to the canonical root of the Git working tree that contains it (GET /v2/git/resolve, control grant). The gateway resolves the folder again on every Git call; this answer is what the phone shows and sends back, never a capability.

root.description: Canonical absolute path of the working tree's top level.

name.description: The root's last path component, for display.

kind.description: A plain repository, a linked worktree (`git worktree add`, whose .git is a file), or a submodule checkout. Bare repositories are refused, not reported.
